- [ ] No private course content, answer keys, student data, credentials, generated binaries, or local paths are included.
- [ ] `project.yml` and its checked-in generated Xcode project were updated together where applicable.
- [ ] User-visible changes are represented in `CHANGELOG.md` and relevant documentation.
